name: nemoclaw

required_env.name: NEMOCLAW_PROVIDER
required_env.hint: Inference provider (nvidia-prod, openai-api, anthropic-prod, gemini-api, compatible-endpoint)

required_env.name: NEMOCLAW_INFERENCE_API_KEY
required_env.hint: API key for the inference provider

optional_env.name: NEMOCLAW_SUBDOMAIN
optional_env.hint: Subdomain for the NemoClaw dashboard (auto-generated if not set)

optional_env.name: NEMOCLAW_AUTH_TOKEN
optional_env.hint: Gateway auth token (auto-generated if not set)

optional_env.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
optional_env.hint: Telegram bot token for messaging channel

optional_env.name: TELEGRAM_USER_ID
optional_env.hint: Telegram user ID for DM allowlist

optional_env.name: DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN
optional_env.hint: Discord bot token for messaging channel

optional_env.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
optional_env.hint: Slack bot token for messaging channel

optional_env.name: BRAVE_API_KEY
optional_env.hint: Brave Search API key for web search capability

description: NVIDIA NemoClaw AI agent sandbox with OpenShell security (Landlock + seccomp + netns)
